items.t: Ladner's apartment buildings cluster around Ladner Village and the Ladner Trunk Road corridor, in Delta.
The village core sits west of Chilukthan Slough, under the Official Community Plan (OCP) Ladner Village Core development permit area.
Current applications anchor the corridor at 5625 and 5737 Ladner Trunk Road, under OCP Bylaw No. 8400 (2024).
Ladner's apartment stock is low-rise: current proposals are five storeys at 5625 Ladner Trunk Road and six storeys at 5737 Ladner Trunk Road.
The 5625 site is currently townhouses, which would be demolished if the apartment redevelopment is approved.

blocks.text: Ladner Condos: rules that affect buyers

items.t: A Ladner Village (LV1) development permit controls form and character for new village-area apartments; both corridor applications require one.
The Ladner Village Core guidelines require development to reinforce historic buildings and intimate scale, and state the village is floodplain behind dikes.
Parking can be varied: 5737 Ladner Trunk Road seeks 42 spaces instead of 86.

blocks.text: Ladner Condos: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Ladner Exchange, 4645 Harvest Drive, sits beside Delta Hospital, so Harvest Drive owners live beside the bus loop.
Ladner Pioneer Library is at 4683 51st Street.
A seasonal 900 Bike Bus runs from Ladner Exchange to Bridgeport Station.
The City lists Chisholm Street Wharf as in progress; Ladner Village Market and Elliott Street Wharf are complete.
Ladner Area catchment maps were last updated October 2017; use the School Locator.

Route 620 is the express link to Bridgeport Station and the Tsawwassen ferry.

blocks.text: Ladner Condos: risks and due diligence

items.t: Treat flood as building-level: the village is floodplain behind dikes, so ask at what level habitable floors and parkade sit.
Drainage behind the buildings is 31 pump stations and about 538 kilometres of drainage infrastructure.

Ladner condos: what sold, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026

49 condos sold in Ladner with a median price of $600,000 (the middle half sold between $529,000 and $655,700), taking a median of 35 days to sell at 97.0% of the last list price; 2% sold above list. They had a median $584 per square foot, a median year built of 1996 and a median strata fee of $495 a month.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: What did condos in Ladner sell for?
faq.a: 49 condos sold in Ladner between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $600,000.

faq.q: How long do condos take to sell in Ladner?
faq.a: The median was 35 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.0% of the last list price (2% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most condos in Ladner sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 49 condos that sold in Ladner went for between $529,000 and $655,700, around a median of $600,000.

faq.q: Do condos in Ladner sell above asking price?
faq.a: 2% of the 49 condos sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 97.0% of it.

faq.q: What is a typical strata fee for condos in Ladner?
faq.a: Of the 49 sales, 49 listings gave a monthly fee and the median was $495.

faq.q: How old are the condos that sold in Ladner?
faq.a: The median year built was 1996 for the 49 condos sold in Ladner.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do condos in Ladner usually have?
faq.a: The median condo that sold in Ladner had 2 bedrooms, from the 49 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Which Ladner communities sold the most condos?
faq.a: By number sold: Delta Manor (22), Hawthorne (10), Neilsen Grove (9), for November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
